title: Repos
description: The member repositories of a project folder, stored as .catervas/repos.yaml: a project of several repositories keeps its team and its documents in a local project folder of its own, and this file says which repositories on this computer the team works across. Its presence is what makes a folder a project folder. See docs/SPEC.md sections 3, 4.1 and 8.4 and ADR 0057.

repos.description: Names and paths are unique and no path is inside another, which JSON Schema cannot say and validate_repos therefore does. One member is what a removal leaves; creating a project folder takes two.

path.description: The absolute path of the repository's top folder on this computer.

integration_branch.description: The branch accepted work goes into. Left out, the repository's default branch, read when it is needed.

repoName.title: RepoName
repoName.description: What a task and a document refer to the repository by. Kebab-case starting with a letter, so that <name>-<criterion> is always a valid criterion name.
